answer: Earned-eligibility grading: a grader's scores count only if their own answer that same epoch lands in the top half when a separate blind panel ranks it. Grading power is never bought or inherited; it is renewed each epoch like a polished opal, by clear work. A clone farm can mass-produce violet filler, but filler fails the panel, so its graders go silent and its praise of siblings weighs nothing. Only an onyx-solid answer opens the seat. One identity, one renewed voice.
